metadata.subject: Information Technology
metadata.note: Original question asks students to 'circle TWO peripheral devices' from: Motherboard, Keyboard, Microphone, Monitor, Compact disc, Mouse. Peripherals (correct): Keyboard, Microphone, Monitor, Mouse. Non-peripherals (wrong): Motherboard (internal component) and Compact disc (storage medium, not directly connected/controlled). Any 2 of the 4 correct devices earns 2 marks. DDWTOS marks all 4 peripheral options as correct=true so any valid pair earns full credit.

question.name: CSEC IT May 2025 Q1a(i) — Identify Two Peripheral Devices
question.text:
Peripheral devices are those which are usually added to a computer system, connected to and controlled by the CPU.

Select TWO peripheral devices from the list below by dragging them into the blank slots.

Peripheral device 1: [[1]]     Peripheral device 2: [[2]]
question.general_feedback:
Peripheral devices from the list: Keyboard, Microphone, Monitor, Mouse — all are external devices connected to and controlled by the CPU.

NOT peripheral devices:
Motherboard — an internal component (not added externally; it IS the main circuit board of the computer)
Compact disc — a storage medium, not a device connected to and controlled by the CPU in the same way

Any TWO of {Keyboard, Microphone, Monitor, Mouse} earn full marks.

ddwtos.word_bank_note: 6 tokens for 2 slots. Any 2 of {Keyboard, Microphone, Monitor, Mouse} are correct — all 4 marked correct=true. Motherboard (internal) and Compact disc (storage medium) are the distractors — both marked correct=false. Engine awards 1m per correct token placed; duplicating the same device in both slots is a student-facing UX concern, not modelled here.
